ValidationRule.description: To restrict updation in PORT field value when the override flag is disabled. CRM - 8544
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Freight_Port__c),Port_Override_Flag__c=False , Freight_AWB_Number__c <> '', NOT( ISCHANGED( Freight_AWB_Number__c ) ) , IsPortEnabled__c = False, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $User.FirstName<>'System Admin' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If PORT change required, please tick Port-Override-flag.
